Inspired by pedals inspired by a mythical circuit, Fault is an overdrive pedal that ranges from boost to distortion with ample control over voicing. A wide control set can make this the only gain pedal on your board, though of course it loves to stack as well. Controls include Vol , Gain 1, and Voice to set the sound of the primary overdrive Boost toggle to set the range and voice of Gain 1 Gain 2 to introduce additional gain when the Gain 2 footswitch is pressed Three band EQ where Low , Mid , and High control the post-drive voice of the pedal Crush toggle to add additional clipping at the very last stage in the circuit Soft-touch bypass footswitch for true bypass and minimal switch noise For more information, see the Fault manual available here . Requires 9V DC center negative 2.1mm jack power supply capable of 60mA (not included).
